title: One comment. Different rules. Explicit evidence.
summary: Rule-conditioned classification with support-adapted language models, leakage-aware evaluation, and checkpointed research. Review how the system distinguishes policy transfer from memorizing overlapping comments.
scope: The dependency-free check verifies the browser publication boundary. Optional Node checks execute the actual TF-IDF policy engine, duplicate purging, conflicting-support rejection, and controls. Historical neural results are reviewed separately through saved evidence.
private_boundary: Private comments, labels, model weights, embeddings, prediction rows, exact ensemble specifications, and active inference orchestration remain excluded. Synthetic margins are not calibrated probabilities.

cards.title: Condition on the policy, not only the comment.
cards.decision: Represent supplied rules and support examples explicitly rather than treating moderation as a fixed global label.
cards.boundary: The small public lexical demo is not the retained Qwen model.

cards.title: Make query/support leakage an explicit failure mode.
cards.decision: Use policy-aware evaluation and purge overlapping query text from fitted or support sources.
cards.boundary: The repeatedly inspected development population is not a fresh holdout.

cards.title: Preserve resumable inference and training boundaries.
cards.decision: Keep run identities, checkpoints, and reporting contracts in the execution layer instead of relying on notebook state.
cards.boundary: Published components do not reconstruct private model artifacts.

cards.title: Distinguish a matched effect from a later aggregate score.
cards.decision: Reconcile saved submission comparisons and development evidence without merging incompatible populations.
cards.boundary: The review validates published arithmetic, not unseen-label predictions.
